UI_HU_Opt_Info: Watches the Workshop download when you host from the menu. If "Downloaded X of Y" stops moving, it presses Stop and Start for you; the server continues from the same item. Also shows a readable status and an honest progress bar.
UI_HU_Opt_Enabled: Restart the server automatically when the download stalls
UI_HU_Opt_Enabled_tt: Off: only the readable status, item name and progress bar; nothing is restarted.
UI_HU_Opt_StallSeconds: Seconds without progress before a restart
UI_HU_Opt_StallSeconds_tt: Counted from the last change of the "Downloaded X of Y" counter; big items get extra time from their size. With the Java part it is counted from the last downloaded byte: after this time the server requests the stuck item again, and if that does not help within 20 s the server is restarted; a server that stops reporting for 30 s (frozen inside Steam) is restarted at once. Every restart on the same item doubles the wait, so a slow but working download is not interrupted forever.
UI_HU_Opt_MaxRestarts_tt: After that many restarts the watchdog gives up and names the item it was stuck on. Pressing Start yourself resets the counter.
UI_HU_Opt_LaunchTimeout: Seconds to wait for the Workshop step
UI_HU_Opt_LaunchTimeout_tt: If the freshly started server does not reach the Workshop download (or Steam does not list the items) within this time, it is restarted too.
UI_HU_Opt_JavaInfo: Java part (optional, needs ZombieBuddy, experimental): the server you host gets the mod's own download loop. Several items are requested from Steam at once instead of one after another, and a download that stops moving is requested again before anything is restarted. If Steam does not start the queued downloads by itself, the loop goes back to one at a time. Without ZombieBuddy these two settings do nothing.
UI_HU_Opt_Parallel: Parallel Workshop downloads on the hosted server
UI_HU_Opt_Parallel_tt: Off: the game's own download loop runs on the server (one item at a time), only the watchdog above works.
UI_HU_Opt_MaxParallel_tt: How many Workshop items the hosted server requests from Steam at once. 4 is a safe default; more rarely helps.
UI_HU_Line_Query: waiting for Steam to list the items: %1 / %2 s
UI_HU_Line_Launch: waiting for the server to reach the Workshop step: %1 / %2 s
UI_HU_Line_JavaOff: Java part switched off after %1 server deaths
UI_HU_Status_Restarting: Download stalled, restarting the server (attempt %1 of %2)...
UI_HU_Status_Relaunch: Server restarted automatically (%1 of %2), continuing the download...
UI_HU_Status_GaveUp: Host Unstuck gave up after %1 restarts. Last item: %2. Check it in the Workshop or remove it from the server's Workshop list.
UI_HU_Status_ItemFailed: Steam could not download item %1, the server retries it...
